name: SSC CGL

uploads.label: Signature
rules: Blurred or miniature signatures are rejected.
conflicts: Para 9.6 gives the width as about 6.0 cm; Annexure IV gives about 4.0 cm. Height is 2.0 cm in both. This preset uses 6.0 cm from the main text.

notes: The photograph is not uploaded as a file. The form captures a live photo by webcam or phone, and a photo of an existing photograph is rejected.
Live photo: plain background, good light, camera at eye level, face fully inside the frame, no cap, mask or glasses.
Applications authenticated through Aadhaar are not rejected on photo or signature grounds.
Candidates without Aadhaar upload proof of name, date of birth, address and gender at One Time Registration; the notice gives no format or size for these.
